Hi Alyssa (and procurement team),

Thanks for raising this. Below is a concise proposal that aligns with our SOC 2 controls and supports an EMEA-first retention posture. I've attached a CSV mapping the log categories to retention tiers and a short PDF with SLA language we can add as an amendment. Also attached: step-by-step snapshot handoff notes.

Proposal (summary):
- Regional residency: Redwood can keep audit logs for EEA customers stored in our Frankfurt region for 24 months (subject to your account being configured on our EMEA tenancy). No customer-visible change to API behavior; logs are stored and retained per the attached mapping.
- One-time snapshot: we can generate a one-time export of the requested 3-month window. Export format: compressed JSONL or CSV (we recommend JSONL for fidelity). Transfer options: (a) Secure SFTP endpoint (customer-provided), (b) Pre-signed HTTPS object in a customer-configured S3 bucket (cross-account), or (c) encrypted transfer to a Redwood-managed temporary bucket + customer pull.
- Lead time & steps (estimates):
  • Request acknowledged and scheduling: 3 business days
  • Export generation: 2–4 business days (depends on volume)
  • Transfer & verification: 1–2 business days
  • Total typical window: 6–9 business days after scheduling
- Security & verification: exports include SHA-256 checksums; transfers are logged and we provide a receipt of handoff with hash and file manifest.
- Contract / pricing: regional retention to 24 months can be added as a free retention-carve (no baseline fee) if you move to EMEA tenancy and commit to an annual renewal. The one-time snapshot is treated as a professional-services-style handoff: standard one-time fee (we estimate $2,400 for up to 5 TB; tiered pricing beyond). We can waive the fee for existing enterprise customers over $500k ARR — happy to discuss.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm you want the EMEA tenancy switch (we'll schedule the migration).
2) Confirm snapshot transfer method (SFTP vs cross-account).
3) If procurement wants the retention language attached to the SLA, point us to the contract team or I can prepare a short amendment for signature.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-log-mapping.csv; retention-sla-proposal.pdf; snapshot-handoff-steps.txt

Happy to jump on a 20-min call if that helps — available tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Laura Bennett
